component.name: DriveBeacon
DriveBeacon
component.summary: Monitor and control OneDrive synchronization from Plasma
Supervisa y controla la sincronización de OneDrive desde Plasma

description.p: DriveBeacon is a KDE system tray client and headless service for Microsoft Graph OneDrive synchronization. It supports multiple accounts, on-demand materialization, a FUSE view, and optional legacy abraunegg migration.

DriveBeacon es un cliente de bandeja de KDE y un servicio sin interfaz para sincronizar OneDrive mediante Microsoft Graph. Admite varias cuentas, materialización bajo demanda, una vista FUSE y la migración opcional desde abraunegg.
Add a maintained release changelog and document the release workflow.
Improve FUSE metadata handling and persist adopted remote folders.
